svg.aria-label: Five fractals of dimension one half with their dial values
svg.title: Five fractals of dimension one half with their dial values

g.text: Five fractals, all of dimension ½, told apart by hidden dials
Each row: the stick [0,1] cut down level by level (top = level 0). Same dimension, different shapes.
Dimension ½ for all five: the square roots of the zooms add to 1 (Lean: half_dimension_certificates).
B and C have the same pieces and zoom; only placement moves, and only lacunarity and content notice.
